note: Maturity PER CLAIM (Sector Brain Model). One experimental claim must not poison the apparent maturity of the others. Statuses are a closed vocabulary; a status here never claims more than its evidence (`evidence` points at the artefact). Customer exposure for every claim is NONE (shadow).

claims.label: Current lake level (consumed from Lake Brain)
claims.evidence: docs/brains/depth/DEPTH_PILOT_INPUT_VERIFICATION.md (equals the operator feeds; units, freshness, sanity checked)

claims.label: Reference (normal/full) pool elevation
claims.scope: lakes with a high/medium directory pool figure (353)
claims.evidence: engine directory + operator sources recorded per lake (reference.referencePoolSource)

claims.label: Level and reference pool share a vertical datum
claims.scope: {verifiedDatum} verified; {inferredOperatorSystem} TVA operator-system inferred; rest UNKNOWN

claims.label: Level shift = current level minus reference pool
claims.evidence: formula/sign/edge cases in tests; live inputs equal operator feeds; shift arithmetic exact

claims.label: Shift uncertainty (pool, level, datum sigma)
claims.evidence: contract.py SIGMA_*; flagged sigmaAssumed (research estimates, not instrument specs)

claims.label: Shallow-band shares from authoritative contours at the survey pool
claims.scope: {referenceZoneLakes} contour lakes (tier A/B); only edges the contour interval supports
claims.evidence: method vs exact TWDB area-capacity tables (MAE 0.010-0.026 at 1-5 ft intervals)

claims.label: Dry/shallow bounds after the level shift (survey-verified lakes)
claims.scope: {effectiveZoneEligible} TWDB lakes; dry and under-3-ft bands only

claims.label: Dry / under 3 / 3-6 / 6-10 ft shares of the reference-pool surface from an operator elevation-area rating or Reclamation survey table
claims.scope: {ratingZoneLakes} lakes ({ratingZoneEligible} with a defensible shift); shares only, never where
claims.evidence: docs/brains/depth/DEPTH_STAGE_AREA_RATING_RULES.md (RATING-ZONE-RULES-1: frame, range, monotone and cross-check rules; exact function of provider-published tables, with area derived from a storage rating where no area rating exists (validated on 89 lakes with both: median |difference| 0.0016, p90 0.020); cross-checked against independent contour surveys on 27 lakes: median |difference| 0.044, 90th percentile 0.127, reported as shareToleranceAbs; vintage published; not validated against the physical lake)

claims.label: Dry / shallow bounds after the level shift for rated lakes
claims.scope: {ratingZoneEligible} lakes with a rating and a defensible shift
claims.evidence: exact arithmetic on the rating (tests/test_rating_zones.py); bounds reflect the level-shift uncertainty only; the reported share tolerance is carried beside them

claims.label: Same, for other contour lakes
claims.evidence: docs/brains/depth/DEPTH_CONTOUR_EFFECTIVE_ZONE_VALIDATION.md (preregistered validation failed; survey-date water level missing)

claims.label: A known flat is now DRY / TOO_SHALLOW / SHOOTABLE / GOOD / DEEP
Absolute depth, flats, drop-offs, channels, bathymetry
